plainTranslation: Your drives fire the same way. Strong physical charge, aligned energy, and head-on collision when you disagree. Great in bed, combustible in a fight. Failure mode: two people who both push and neither yields. Point the shared energy at a common goal; learn to fight without trying to win.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: You go after what you want in very similar ways, so you move in strong sync and also collide. Two identical drives that both want the wheel. Decide who leads on what before the trip, not during.
tension: The growth opportunity comes when your strengths become overused. Two highly driven people can easily slip into power struggles, impatience, or competition. You may both want to lead, both feel strongly about your approach, or both react quickly when frustrated. In those moments, it is important to remember that being right is not the same as moving forward.
advice: The key is to stay focused on the bigger picture. When you direct your shared energy toward a common goal, this connection becomes incredibly productive. Instead of competing with each other, challenge yourselves to build, create, and grow together. Your greatest success comes when you act as partners, not opponents.
summaryShort: You go after what you want in very similar ways, so you move in strong sync and also collide.
